title: Rapid AM scratchpad and errands
content:
6:50am quick brain dump
- Wake, tea, 10 min stretch. Try not to check email before stand.
- Today small goals: (1) unblock canary rollout config, (2) finalize playground UX notes, (3) grocery + dry cleaner.

Top work TODOs
- Review RINF-1423 (canary routing policy): confirm fallback policy wording + add test cases (Samir asked for example request traces).
- PR review: GH PR #3287 (playground prompt templates) — focus on example coverage for streaming and tool calls. Leave one inline comment about default timeout.
- Add one-line summary for CONF-2342 (playground rollout plan) for product sync at 11:30. Bring up risk: token-count regression metrics not captured in current eval set.
- Quick perf probe: run local batch experiment for 2048 seq (use qa-batch-config-3), capture p50/p95. Note: reminders to set --kv-cache=enabled.

Meetings / schedule
- 9:00 stand (15m) — note: mention on-call rotation update + SLO incident follow-up from yesterday (link to thread in #sre-incidents).
- 11:30 product sync (30m) — bring rollout summary + one-pager (CONF-2342)
- 3:00 pairing with Leah on UX microcopy (30m)

Errands / personal
- Drop suit at Joes Dry Cleaners (before 12pm)
- Grocery: milk, eggs, spinach, blueberries, oat milk (for office), small bunch cilantro — aim to shop at the co-op near 5th st.
- Post office: return small package (label ready).
- Pick up contact lens solution (optometrist next week reminder).

Notes to self / quick ideas
- Idea: add small inline tooltip in playground for "estimated token cost" that shows both token-est and dollar-est for last 3 models used. Low priority but good for demos.
- If we expose per-route cache metrics, highlight cache hit rate and recent evictions in console. Add to product feedback list.
- For canary: if latency spike > 30% for > 3 consecutive mins, auto-revert and notify channel #canary-alerts. Draft policy: revert threshold, cool-down 10m, manual override allowed.

Unresolved / follow-ups
- Ask infra if we can spin up a tiny dedicated cluster for smoke tests (cost estimate needed). (Samir?)
- Who owns the token-estimation UX copy? Add Leah as owner in CONF doc draft.
- Confirm whether the eval harness includes streaming tests (I think not). If not, file small ticket.

Quick checklist for end of day
- [ ] Push comments on PR #3287
- [ ] Update CONF-2342 with two-sentence summary and link to replay
- [ ] Send note to #dev-dx with perf probe results
- [ ] Errands done (dry cleaner + grocery + post office)

Random scratch lines (brain dump)
- Remember: don't hardcode model name in examples; use model aliasing so customers can pin versions.
- Look up previous incident timeline: search slack for "Mar 22 canary revert"
- If time, prototype small flag in UI for "show token estimate" — toggle for internal builds only.

End of morning note. Will tidy up after product sync.
